phase: Phase 7.0b — generator-family Flate corpus (ReportLab, Cairo, LibreOffice, pdfTeX) + complete-cost court
claim: On four locally generated real-authoring-generator families (ReportLab 3.6.12, Cairo 1.20.1/libcairo 1.16.0, LibreOffice Writer 7.4.7.2, pdfTeX 3.141592653-2.6-1.40.24), exact DEFLATE replay accepts 87/87 Flate streams (acceptance 1.000). Under the real complete-cost court PDF_DEFLATE_REPLAY_RANS beats BYTE_RANS on 1/4 files: the Cairo vector output by 24,137 B (58,711 -> 34,574), where Cairo emitted 6 byte-identical page content streams. ReportLab (small file, framing overhead), pdfTeX (already-tight streams) and LibreOffice (no whole-stream sharing) lose. This is the first authoring-generator witness of the Phase-6/7.0 shared-plaintext win region; the win is conditional on repeated identical page content and is not a population claim.
dirty_note: No src/wire/candidate change. The unforced court winners all verify and round-trip byte-for-byte.
command: docker compose run --rm --no-TTY producers sh tools/pdf-corpus-producers.sh; docker compose run --rm --no-TTY dev sh -c './target/debug/vole-document deflate-stats evidence/corpus/phase7-producers/*.pdf > evidence/corpus/phase7-producers/deflate-stats.jsonl'; docker compose run --rm --no-TTY dev sh -c 'sh tools/pdf-court.sh evidence/scratch/court-producers evidence/corpus/phase7-producers/*.pdf'

determinism.note: Each family is generated twice by tools/pdf-corpus-producers.sh and the two SHA-256s compared. LibreOffice embeds run-varying metadata; the caveat is recorded in provenance.json. qpdf /ID normalization is applied only when it leaves every Flate payload byte-identical.
